changelog:
v1.32.0 - Restructure in-game Pause (ESC) Menu: split Character/Inventory and Settings/Gameplay tabs, implement left vertical sub-navigation for Graphics & Performance settings, replace checkboxes with sliding toggles, and implement reset-to-defaults functionality.
v1.31.0 - **Night-crowd performance pass — mass-death/chaos optimizations + Performance Effects toggles (v1.31.0).** Targets the framerate drops in late-game (min 13+) night scenes where many enemies die at once. **Visually-neutral (always on):** **(N1)** enemy health bars no longer re-render every frame — the per-enemy `SubViewport` is `UPDATE_ONCE` (re-armed only when HP changes) and is created lazily on first damage instead of for every enemy in `_ready()`, so a full-HP crowd of ~90 no longer drives ~90 always-updating render targets; **(N2)** GPU particle *collision* was removed from the high-count gore splat materials (DeathVFX 240 + BloodVFX 100) — they were doing per-particle SDF tests against the scene's 1000³ `GPUParticlesCollisionBox3D`; the low-count parent emitters that trigger the splash are kept, so the burst still appears; **(N3)** a per-frame budget caps full death sprays at 6/frame (excess mass-death kills skip the spray but still drop loot, play sound, and emit signals); **(N4)** a new `DropBatcher` coalesces same-frame XP/coin drops — individual when few, merged into ≤4 higher-value orbs when many die together (total value preserved), killing the spawn spike and the standing pickup-pile physics; **(N5)** dead enemies are made inert immediately (`PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED`, out of groups/collision/`active_enemies`) and freed a few per frame instead of tearing down many node trees in one frame — this also fixed a bug the staggering surfaced where a corpse's still-ticking `WeaponSystem`, now out of the `enemy` group, misrouted into the player aim branch; **(N6)** the two health-bar `StyleBoxFlat`s are shared across all enemies instead of allocated per enemy. **Opt-in "Performance Effects" toggles (new pause-menu group, all default OFF so the stock look is unchanged):** **(V1)** *Reduce night glow/bloom* (dials glow intensity 1.4→1.0, strength 1.2→1.0, HDR threshold 0.5→0.7, bloom cap 0.4); **(V2)** *Disable volumetric fog* (keeps cheap depth fog, drops the 3D light-shaft pass — a large night GPU saving); **(V3)** *Disable SSAO*; **(V4)** *Dynamic resolution* (eases the internal 3D scale down via FSR when frames dip below ~45 fps and back up on recovery, with hysteresis); **(V5)** *Simplified death effects* (minimal burst, no big splash); **(V6)** *Reduced blood/gore* (halves blood + death particle counts); **(V7)** *Cull distant night lights* (hides window lights >35 m from the player; their on/off is energy-driven so visibility is safe to toggle). Flags persist in the save with `false` migration defaults; `set_perf_flag` + `perf_graphics_changed` drive live/static consumers. Verified: clean headless `--import`; all 10 CI regression suites pass; `DropBatcher` merge-math and the settings/V5/V6 particle-scaling behaviorally checked headless. **Still wants an in-editor eyeball** (headless can't confirm GPU visuals): the N2 splat look, and each V-toggle's visual delta. The full MultiMesh/shader-quad health-bar rewrite (drops the SubViewport entirely but changes the bar's rounded-corner look) was intentionally left as a documented follow-up since it needs visual verification and N1 already removes the per-frame cost.
v1.30.0 - **Root-cause fixes: intermittent "no projectile" + missing-terrain bugs (v1.30.0).** Two long-standing Heisenbugs traced to their actual roots. **(1) Ranged weapons that played their sound + animation but fired NO projectile** (Razzi, Akimbo and others, in bursts right after an enemy died or after the player was hit) were caused by a *freed-object typed assignment*: `WeaponSystem._do_ranged` read the player's locked/hovered enemy straight into a typed `Node3D` target, but when that enemy had just died the reference was already freed, and assigning a freed object into a typed var **throws in Godot 4** -- aborting the shot after the sound/anim but before the spawn loop (no projectile, no muzzle flash, no explosion). The locked/hovered and homing targets are now read into untyped locals and `is_instance_valid()`-guarded before use. **(2) Intermittent missing terrain/obstacles** (blue-grid floor while enemies still spawned) was the **Godot 4.7 global-class registration race**: a script reaching another `class_name`'s *static* members by bare name can fail to resolve when compiled early or on a worker thread. Hardened systemically -- ten pure static-utility scripts (`MapConfig`, `CombatUtils`, `DamageResolver`, `StatusEffects`, `StatusVFX`, `ProjectileVisualBuilder`, `UIStyles`, `StatFormatter`, `KeybindsTabBuilder`, `CelShadingTabBuilder`) dropped `class_name` and are now reached via `const X = preload(...)` in every consumer; type-classes that also expose statics (`Enemy`/`Prop`) route their static reads through differently-named preload-consts (`EnemyClass`/`PropClass`) while keeping `class_name` for casts. **Tooling:** added `tools/run_godot.sh`, a failsafe that refuses to launch a second Godot instance (a concurrent headless `--editor`/`--import` next to an open editor corrupts `.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg`). All temporary fire-lifecycle diagnostics were removed. **Also in this release:** projectile *homing* is now enabled across 19 weapon / secondary / level-up entries (the steering mechanic already existed in code but had no config to drive it) -- affected shots curve toward the locked/hovered target and re-acquire mid-flight. Verified: clean headless editor compile (zero parse/script errors), a healthy class cache, and the headless regression suites pass.
